features.title: Reliable dictation and explicit self-correction

obligations.acceptance: Only an acknowledged exact field/text/caret receipt permits cross-turn replacement; changed ownership and unconfirmed writes never retry.
Explicit restart replaces stale words and dictionary echo retries locally.
Queued stale turns and focus drift cannot deliver into a new target.

Recognize public/prerecorded multilingual speech through actual engine; insert/correct only in disposable focused fixture, interrupted/offline and cross-turn cases. Keep transcript, focus events and exact model/binary hashes.

Generated WAV data rejects truncated or oversized chunks, unsupported PCM metadata, partial samples and inconsistent container sizes while accepting valid empty and padded containers and sliced Data. This decoder proof does not capture audio, validate a speech provider or establish dictation quality.

Generated PCM is supplied once with explicit live/final statuses; stateful converter rejects overlap without blocking and recovers afterward. Sequential conversion with reused input storage matches complete final output. This does not establish recognition, capture privacy or physical latency.

features.title: Native Meetings recording, transcription and speaker identification

obligations.acceptance: Actual injected controller saves before completed feedback, keeps newer private notes on retry, and stops once after its nine-second confirmation. Does not prove actual hardware/ASR/window behavior.
Acknowledgement precedes recording; final transcript excludes unresolved partials.
Drive native controller with injected dual-source audio, ASR/diarizer, clock and temporary persistence; assert ordered session events and durable recap.
Synthetic known speakers/overlap through real supported audio and recognizer adapters; measure diarization against labeled ground truth and retain trace.

Scribe clusters trained 256-value voice embeddings with the hand-built voiceprint as an unchanged fallback, renames and merges speakers across lines, statistics and exported text, saves voices only into a private local file that can be deleted, suggests names only when an invite, a saved voice or a repeat backs them, and relabels turns the live pass split or merged. Synthetic vectors only: this does not prove WeSpeaker accuracy, the model download, or recognition of real voices.

Call-window labels (English and French), participant tiles and active-speaker spans fold into votes and a per-voice timeline winner; a name binds only when audio and tile agree (enough overlap, clear majority and lead, mutual best, unambiguous window, muted tiles never win); typed names always win, declined names are not offered again, later evidence corrects only automatic names; live names relabel earlier lines; block and word reassignment, undoable edits, pruning of tiny voices and the voice sample clip are pure and tested. Synthetic timelines only: this does not prove what Zoom, Teams, Meet or Slack actually expose through Accessibility, nor the Nemotron streaming path on real audio.

features.title: Strict mute protects every capture and transcription stage

obligations.acceptance: Only fresh allowed evidence permits the actual ingress helper to copy sample memory; mute/unknown/expired/contended states never copy.
Known muted and unknown frames reach neither storage nor ASR.
Inject permission, mute, owner and timestamp transitions at actual callback ingress; forbidden payload never enters ring, recognition or storage.
Automated trace over mute/unmute/unknown transitions and every supported call adapter; zero forbidden payload at each stage. Owner OS consent required for any real capture.

Concurrent watchdog requests admit at most two owned synchronous readers without queueing; stalled readers cannot keep stale mute evidence fresh or let a late unmuted result replace newer mute. This does not prove instantaneous hardware mute.

Per-app shaping probes before any muted tap, destroys every tap first on a call, a Zeus capture, sleep, an output change or a stall, never builds while another copy holds the claim, and keeps the raw copy of unreadable settings, and carries the owner's stored switch over a launch. Fakes only; no real tap.
The equaliser value types, band table, biquad coefficients, app grouping policy, lifecycle reducer and card rules hold on their own, with no tap, device or audio.
The shaping render block routes channels to the device, counts frames and zeros, runs callbacks longer than its scratch in chunks, and writes nothing from the probe block. Synthetic buffers only.
